vitals.astro.age.aquarius: Network, technology and collective — knowledge is distributed, not kept.
vitals.astro.age.aries: Iron, empire and heroism — the self steps out of the group.
vitals.astro.age.capricorn: Structure, limit and duration — what lasts gets built.
vitals.astro.age.gemini: Language, writing and trade — knowledge becomes transferable.
vitals.astro.age.pisces: Faith, sacrifice and institution — truth gets administered.
vitals.astro.age.taurus: Farming, the bull and mother deities — property settles down.
vitals.astro.ascendant-hint: The ascendant needs a birth time and place; it cannot be derived from the date.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.1: Flows around obstacles rather than through them. Independent and observant, needs retreat to get clear — and often reads as more closed than it means to.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.2: Supports, provides, holds things together. Works thoroughly and steadily in the background, and needs time for decisions others expect fast.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.3: Starts loud and early. Enthusiasm, directness, impatience — ideas arrive faster than they get finished.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.4: Moves through contacts and moods. Perceptive and persuasive, easily distracted; direction shifts with the weather.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.5: Sits at the centre and draws things in. Leads naturally, takes on too much, and learns through its own extremes.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.6: Leads by principle and overview. Reliable and demanding, loyal to its own standard — yielding comes hard.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.7: Charming and sociable, good at mediating. Enjoys and seems light, but judges more sharply than it looks.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.8: Persistent and quietly determined. Builds slowly, holds positions, and needs a run-up before anything changes.
vitals.astro.ki.personality.9: Visible, inspiring, quick to judge. Burns bright and needs an audience; attention is both fuel and weak spot.
vitals.astro.no-date: No valid date — pick a date of birth.
vitals.astro.trait.aquarius: Self-willed and forward-thinking — freedom before belonging.
vitals.astro.trait.aries: Starts before the plan is finished — drive without detour.
vitals.astro.trait.cancer: Guards what is its own, and forgets nothing.
vitals.astro.trait.capricorn: Builds for the long run and expects resistance.
vitals.astro.trait.gemini: Alert and agile, thinks by talking it through.
vitals.astro.trait.leo: Takes the stage and means it warmly — generosity likes an audience.
vitals.astro.trait.libra: Weighs until the balance holds — conflict only as a last resort.
vitals.astro.trait.pisces: Permeable and compassionate, with a feel for what goes unsaid.
vitals.astro.trait.sagittarius: Aims far, bores quickly, says it straight.
vitals.astro.trait.scorpio: Goes deep, and withholds what is nobody’s business.
vitals.astro.trait.taurus: Steady and sensual, slow and reluctant to change course.
vitals.astro.trait.virgo: Checks, orders, improves; precision as a form of care.

vitals.iching.judgement.1: The Creative works supreme success, favoured by perseverance.
vitals.iching.judgement.10: Treading on the tiger's tail. It does not bite the man. Success.
vitals.iching.judgement.11: Peace. The small departs, the great draws near. Good fortune! Success!
vitals.iching.judgement.12: Standstill. Bad people are no help to the perseverance of the noble one. The great departs, the small draws near.
vitals.iching.judgement.13: Fellowship with people in the open: success. It is favourable to cross the great water. The perseverance of the noble one is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.14: Possession in great measure: supreme success!
vitals.iching.judgement.15: Modesty creates success. The noble one carries things through.
vitals.iching.judgement.16: Enthusiasm. It is favourable to appoint helpers and to let armies march.
vitals.iching.judgement.17: Following has supreme success. Perseverance is favourable. No fault.
vitals.iching.judgement.18: Work on what has been spoiled has supreme success. It is favourable to cross the great water. Three days before the starting point, three days after the starting point.
vitals.iching.judgement.19: Approach has supreme success. Perseverance is favourable. When the eighth month comes, there is misfortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.2: The Receptive works supreme success, favoured by the perseverance of a mare. If the noble one has something to undertake and pushes ahead, he goes astray; but if he follows, he finds guidance. It is favourable to find friends in the west and south, and to do without friends in the east and north. Quiet perseverance brings good fortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.20: Contemplation. The washing has been done, but not yet the offering. Trustingly they look up to him.
vitals.iching.judgement.21: Biting through has success. It is favourable to let justice be done.
vitals.iching.judgement.22: Grace has success. In small matters it is favourable to undertake something.
vitals.iching.judgement.23: Splitting apart. It is not favourable to go anywhere.
vitals.iching.judgement.24: Return. Success. Going out and coming in without error. Friends come without fault. To and fro goes the way. On the seventh day comes the return. It is favourable to have somewhere to go.
vitals.iching.judgement.25: Innocence. Supreme success. Perseverance is favourable. If someone is not upright, he meets misfortune, and it is not favourable to undertake anything.
vitals.iching.judgement.26: The taming power of the great. Perseverance is favourable. Not eating at home brings good fortune. It is favourable to cross the great water.
vitals.iching.judgement.27: The corners of the mouth. Perseverance brings good fortune. Look to the nourishment, and to what a man seeks to fill his own mouth with.
vitals.iching.judgement.28: Preponderance of the great. The ridgepole sags. It is favourable to have somewhere to go. Success.
vitals.iching.judgement.29: The repeated abyss. If you are truthful, you have success in the heart, and what you do succeeds.
vitals.iching.judgement.3: Difficulty at the beginning works supreme success. Favoured by perseverance. Undertake nothing. It is favourable to appoint helpers.
vitals.iching.judgement.30: The Clinging. Perseverance is favourable. It brings success. Care of the cow brings good fortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.31: Influence. Success. Perseverance is favourable. To take a girl brings good fortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.32: Success. No fault. Perseverance is favourable. It is favourable to have somewhere to go.
vitals.iching.judgement.33: Retreat. Success. In small matters perseverance is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.34: The power of the great. Perseverance is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.35: Progress: the strong prince is honoured with horses in great number. In one day he is received three times.
vitals.iching.judgement.36: The darkening of the light. It is favourable to persevere in adversity.
vitals.iching.judgement.37: The family. The perseverance of the woman is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.38: Opposition. In small matters, good fortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.39: Obstruction. The south-west is favourable. The north-east is not favourable. It is favourable to see the great man. Perseverance brings good fortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.4: Youthful folly has success. It is not I who seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me. At the first oracle I give answer. If he asks twice or three times, that is importunity. If he importunes, I give no answer. Perseverance is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.40: Deliverance. The south-west is favourable. If there is nowhere left to go, returning brings good fortune. If there is still somewhere one must go, then haste brings good fortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.41: Decrease joined with truthfulness works supreme good fortune without fault. One may persevere in it. It is favourable to undertake something. How is this carried out? Two small bowls may be used for the offering.
vitals.iching.judgement.42: Increase. It is favourable to undertake something. It is favourable to cross the great water.
vitals.iching.judgement.43: Breakthrough. The matter must be made known resolutely at the king's court. It must be proclaimed in accordance with the truth. Danger! One must inform one's own city. It is not favourable to take up arms. It is favourable to undertake something.
vitals.iching.judgement.44: Coming to meet. The girl is powerful. One should not marry such a girl.
vitals.iching.judgement.45: Gathering together. Success. The king draws near to his temple. It is favourable to see the great man. That brings success. Perseverance is favourable. To bring great offerings creates good fortune. It is favourable to undertake something.
vitals.iching.judgement.46: Pushing upward has supreme success. One must see the great man. Do not be afraid! Departure to the south brings good fortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.47: Oppression. Success. Perseverance. The great man brings good fortune. No fault. If one has something to say, it is not believed.
vitals.iching.judgement.48: The well. One may change the town, but cannot change the well. It neither decreases nor increases. They come and go and draw from the well. If one has almost reached the well water but is not yet down with the rope, or breaks one’s jug, that brings misfortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.49: Revolution. On your own day you find belief. Supreme success, favoured by perseverance. Regret disappears.
vitals.iching.judgement.5: Waiting. If you are truthful, you have light and success. Perseverance brings good fortune. It is favourable to cross the great water.
vitals.iching.judgement.50: The cauldron. Supreme good fortune. Success.
vitals.iching.judgement.51: Shock brings success. The shock comes: hu, hu! Laughing words: ha, ha! The shock frightens a hundred miles, and he does not let the sacrificial spoon and chalice fall.
vitals.iching.judgement.52: Keeping his back still, so that he no longer feels his body. He goes into his courtyard and does not see his people. No fault.
vitals.iching.judgement.53: Development. The girl is given in marriage. Good fortune! Perseverance is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.54: The marrying maiden. Undertakings bring misfortune. Nothing that would be favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.55: Abundance has success. The king reaches it. Be not sad; you must be like the sun at noon.
vitals.iching.judgement.56: The wanderer. Success through smallness. For the wanderer, perseverance brings good fortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.57: The Gentle. Success through what is small. It is favourable to have somewhere to go. It is favourable to see the great man.
vitals.iching.judgement.58: The Joyous. Success. Perseverance is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.59: Dispersion. Success. The king draws near to his temple. It is favourable to cross the great water. Perseverance is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.6: Conflict: you are truthful and are obstructed. To halt carefully halfway brings good fortune. Carrying it through to the end brings misfortune. It is favourable to see the great man. It is not favourable to cross the great water.
vitals.iching.judgement.60: Limitation. Success. Bitter limitation must not be practised with perseverance.
vitals.iching.judgement.61: Inner truth. Pigs and fishes. Good fortune! It is favourable to cross the great water. Perseverance is favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.62: Preponderance of the small. Success. Perseverance is favourable. One may do small things, one should not do great things. The flying bird brings the message: it is not good to strive upward, it is good to remain below. Great good fortune!
vitals.iching.judgement.63: Success in small matters. Perseverance is favourable. In the beginning good fortune, at the end disorder.
vitals.iching.judgement.64: Before completion. Success. But if the little fox, when he has almost completed the crossing, gets his tail in the water, then there is nothing that would be favourable.
vitals.iching.judgement.7: The army needs perseverance and a strong man. Good fortune without fault.
vitals.iching.judgement.8: Holding together brings good fortune. Question the oracle once more, whether you have sublimity, duration and perseverance; then there is no fault. The uncertain gradually draw near. Whoever comes too late meets misfortune.
vitals.iching.judgement.9: The taming power of the small has success. Dense clouds, no rain from our western region.

vitals.iching.life-reduced: Reduced all the way to 1–9; master numbers (11, 22) are not kept apart.

vitals.iching.life.trait.1: Goes first, even without a map. Self-reliant, impatient with detours, strongest where nobody has been yet.
vitals.iching.life.trait.2: Listens, weighs, holds two sides together. Works quietly and decides later than others expect.
vitals.iching.life.trait.3: Thinks by telling, and finds the form before the content. Easy to inspire, hard to keep on one thing.
vitals.iching.life.trait.4: Builds, checks, repeats. Reliable to the point of stubbornness, and suspicious of every shortcut.
vitals.iching.life.trait.5: Needs movement like air. Curious and changeable, at risk of scattering before anything holds.
vitals.iching.life.trait.6: Cares, orders, carries more than agreed. Its own standard is the strictest in the room.
vitals.iching.life.trait.7: Keeps asking when others are satisfied. Needs solitude, and so reads as more distant than it means to.
vitals.iching.life.trait.8: Thinks in orders of magnitude and delivers. Sure in judgement, and reliant on setting the measure itself.
vitals.iching.life.trait.9: Sees the whole and lets go. Broad-hearted, hard to pin down, and rarely finished with what others have closed.
